title: 笔锋初露路上回望
content_zh:
南下的第二十日，江砚撞上了那伙乱兵。
那天午后，他翻过一道矮坡，远远地，就听见了哭喊。
坡下是一片开阔的荒野，一条官道横贯其间。官道上，一群衣衫褴褛的人，正没命地往南奔逃。男女老少都有，背着包袱，拖着孩子，跌跌撞撞，哭声、喊声，乱成一团。
而在他们身后，七八个骑着马、提着刀的兵卒，正吆喝着、嬉笑着，追在后头。
那不是官军。
是乱兵。
大胤衰世，边患连年，朝廷的兵，欠饷的欠饷，溃散的溃散。这些散了建制、没了约束的兵卒，比马匪还狠——他们成伙游荡在道上，专挑逃难的流民下手，抢粮、抢钱、抢人，抢完了，往往还要杀人取乐。
江砚伏在坡上的草丛里，心一点一点，沉了下去。
他看见一个乱兵，纵马撞翻了一个跑得慢的老汉，那老汉惨叫一声，被马蹄踏过，再没爬起来。
他看见另一个乱兵，伸手揪住一个妇人的发髻，把她从孩子身边，硬生生拽倒在地。那妇人怀里的孩子，哇哇大哭。
他看见一个十来岁的小子，攥着根烧火棍，红着眼睛挡在家人前头，被一个乱兵一脚踹翻，那乱兵狞笑着，举起了刀——
江砚的心，猛地一缩。
那小子，攥着烧火棍、红着眼挡在家人前头的样子……
像极了沈家村那个，攥着半块饼、梗着脖子不肯松手的，自己。
“走啊。”
江砚伏在草里，听见自己心里有个声音。
“这不关你的事。手札里写着——藏锋。墨痕招祸。你身子还虚，你一个人，斗不过七八个提刀的兵。你绕过去，往南，没人会知道。”
这声音说得有道理。
太有道理了。
江砚的手，已经撑在地上，要往后退。

可那个攥着烧火棍的小子，那把就要落下的刀，那哇哇大哭的孩子，那被马蹄踏过、再没爬起来的老汉——
死死地，钉在他眼睛里。
他想起秦伯。
想起那个孤老头子，在破庙里，几乎是不假思索地，把他往豁口外一推，自己迎着那柄死刀，扑了上去。
老头那时，为什么不“藏锋”？为什么不绕开？
因为老头护的，是人。
江砚又想起手札最后那一页，那句沉得像刻进去的话——
“吾辈执笔，非为夺天地之造化，乃为补天地之残缺。”
“存护念者，造物虽弱，却安。”
他还想起，自己在那块界石上，对着北方立下的那颗心——
力量是用来护人的。不是用来炫的。也不是用来，眼睁睁看着人被杀、自己却缩在草里逃命的。
江砚撑在地上的手，停住了。
他没有往后退。
他闭上眼，深深地，吸了一口气。
content_en:
On the twentieth day of his journey south, Jiang Yan ran into that group of rebel soldiers.
That afternoon, he climbed over a low slope and heard crying in the distance.
Down the slope is an open wilderness with an official road running through it. On the official road, a group of ragged people were running southward desperately. There were men, women, and children, carrying baggage and dragging children, stumbling around, crying and shouting, and it was a chaotic mess.
Behind them, seven or eight soldiers on horseback and carrying swords were chasing after them, shouting and laughing.
That's not the official army.
They are rebels.
Dayin was in decline, and border troubles continued for years. The soldiers of the imperial court were in disarray and disintegrated. These disorganized and unruly soldiers are more ruthless than horse bandits - they roam the roads in groups, specifically picking out refugees who are fleeing, and rob food, money, and people. After robbing, they often kill people for fun.
Jiang Yan lay in the grass on the slope, his heart sinking little by little.
He saw a rebel soldier knocking over a slow-running old man with his horse. The old man screamed and was trampled by the horse's hooves, and he never got up again.
He saw another rebel, reaching out and grabbing a woman's hair, pulling her away from the child and forcefully knocking her to the ground. The child in the woman's arms was crying loudly.
He saw a boy in his teens, holding a fire stick and standing in front of his family with red eyes. He was kicked over by a rebel soldier. The soldier smiled grimly and raised his knife——
Jiang Yan's heart suddenly shrank.
That kid, holding a fire stick and standing in front of his family with red eyes...
Very much like the one in Shenjia Village, holding half a piece of cake and holding his neck and refusing to let go, himself.
"Let's go."
Jiang Yan was lying in the grass and heard a voice in his heart.
"It's none of your business. It's written in the handbook - Hidden Feng. Mo Hen brings trouble. You are still weak, and you alone can't fight against seven or eight soldiers with swords. You go around and go south, no one will know."
The voice had a point.
It makes so much sense.
Jiang Yan's hands were already on the ground and he was about to step back.
But the boy holding the fire stick, the knife about to fall, the crying child, the old man who was trampled by the horse's hooves and never got up again——
Deadly, nailed into his eyes.
He thought of Uncle Qin.
Thinking of the lonely old man in the ruined temple, he pushed him out of the gap almost without thinking, and rushed forward to face the death knife.
Why didn't the old man "hide the front" at that time? Why not go around it?
Because the old man protects people.
Jiang Yan thought of the last page of the letter again, the words that were as heavy as if they were carved into it——
"We write, not to seize the good fortune of heaven and earth, but to make up for the imperfections of heaven and earth."
"Those who keep the thought of protecting things will be safe even though their creations are weak."
He also thought of the heart he had set on that boundary stone facing the north——
Strength is used to protect people. Not for showing off. It's not for watching people being killed while you huddle in the grass and run for your life.
Jiang Yan's hand on the ground stopped.
He didn't step back.
He closed his eyes and took a deep breath.
